## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/masked-text-box`. Each name links to its reference page, with every input, output, property and method.

| Name | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`MaskedTextBoxComponent`](/api/masked-text-box/MaskedTextBoxComponent) | Component | A text box that takes a value in a fixed format, such as a phone number or a postal code. |
| [`MaskedTextBoxPrefixTemplateDirective`](/api/masked-text-box/MaskedTextBoxPrefixTemplateDirective) | Directive | Marks an `<ng-template>` as content before the masked text box's input, such as an icon or a country code. |
| [`MaskedTextBoxSuffixTemplateDirective`](/api/masked-text-box/MaskedTextBoxSuffixTemplateDirective) | Directive | Marks an `<ng-template>` as content after the masked text box's input and its clear button, such as a unit or a button. |
| [`formatMaskedValue`](/api/masked-text-box/formatMaskedValue) | Function | Formats a value for display with its mask's literals, such as `"5551234567"` as `"(555) 123-4567"` for the mask `"(000) 000-0000"`. |
| [`isMaskComplete`](/api/masked-text-box/isMaskComplete) | Function | Whether a value fills every required slot of a mask, for a validator. |

### Types

| Type | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`MASKED_TEXT_BOX_DEFAULT_MESSAGES`](/api/masked-text-box/MASKED_TEXT_BOX_DEFAULT_MESSAGES) | Constant |  |
| [`MaskOptions`](/api/masked-text-box/MaskOptions) | Interface | How a value is read against a mask, for `isMaskComplete` and `formatMaskedValue`. |
| [`MaskRules`](/api/masked-text-box/MaskRules) | Type alias | Mask characters of your own, each mapped to a pattern that one character must match, such as `{ H: /[0-9a-f]/i }` for a hexadecimal digit. |

**Related types:** [`AttributeConfig`](/api/common/AttributeConfig), [`MonaMaskedTextBoxMessages`](/api/i18n/MonaMaskedTextBoxMessages)
